attchmntText: Olectra Greentech Limited has informed the Exchange about sale of entire stake in associate company
voiceSummary: Olectra Greentech Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone net profit for the quarter was 5,092.19 lakhs, with basic earnings per share of 6.20. For the six months, standalone net profit was 7,411.62 lakhs, with basic earnings per share of 9.03. The Board also approved the sale of its entire 34% equity holding in Evey Trans UJJ Private Limited to Evey Trans Private Limited for Rs. 34,000. The buyer is a related party under common control of MEIL Holdings Limited. The transaction is expected to complete within three months. The Share Purchase Agreement is yet to be executed.

attchmntText: Olectra Greentech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
